question: A, B and C start a business. A invests 33(1)/(3)\% of the total capital, B invests 25% of the remaining and C, the rest. If the total profit at the end of the year is ₹2,19,000, then A's share (in ₹) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Let, the total amount = 18

Here, 33(1)/(3)\% = 1/3 and 25% = 1/4

A = 18/3 = 6

B = (18 - 6)/4 = 12/4 = 3

C = 18 - (6 + 3) = 18 - 9 = 9

A : B : C = 6 : 3 : 9

The share of A = (6/18) × 219000 = 73000
